raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the question by downplaying water vapor as a “feedback” and incorrectly claiming its concentration is ~400 ppm (comparable to CO2), leading to the wrong choice of carbon dioxide. In reality, water vapor in the lower atmosphere is highly variable but typically orders of magnitude higher (∼0.2–4% by volume) than CO2 (~0.042%), making water vapor the most abundant greenhouse gas. The agent also prematurely declared the task complete without verification.
